rca of the issue: The user report ('order alert isn't working') had THREE independent root causes stacked, all now fixed and verified: (1) GET /api/vendors/my-orders was serialising raw Mongo docs including ObjectId — FastAPI returned 500. The dashboard polls this endpoint every 15s; every poll errored, so no orders ever loaded, and the alertNewOrders() diff never ran → no banner. FIX: added {'_id':0} projection. (2) Even when the endpoint worked, business (grocery/pharmacy) merchants got zero orders because the endpoint only matched vendor_id, but storefront checkout writes restaurant_id for all vendor types. FIX: match {$or:[{restaurant_id},{vendor_id}]} in both my-orders and stats. (3) Merchant new-order alert was going out via WhatsApp free-form, which Twilio accepts (201) but async-fails with 63005 for un-opted-in merchants — so no SMS ever fell through either. FIX: _notify_merchant_new_order now calls _wa_notify(..., channel='sms') directly, and _wa_notify propagates the channel to twilio_client.send_notification. End-to-end UI verification: banner + toast + orders list + stat cards all update within one 15s poll window. Note: separate seed bug (user_type not flipped to 'business' for the persisted grocery merchant) is documented under action_items — it does not affect the API layer but blocks the /vendor-dashboard UI route until fixed.
